deploy-bot: Deployment request queued for service 'auth-service' -> prod. Tag: v2.14.0 (commit 9f3b2c4). Requested by jessica. Concurrent deploy limit for prod (3) reached; your position: 3. To request preemptive slot reply with 'override:urgent' and get oncall approval.

jessica: This is a GDPR hotfix, needs to go today. Can someone escalate?

aakash: What exactly is in front of us? which jobs are occupying the slots?

deploy-bot: Running in prod: 1) payments-service v3.2.1 (started by marta) 2) insights v1.9.0 (started by aakash). Both considered in-flight.

marta: payments has a DB migration running, ETA ~12m. We can't cancel that mid-migration.

devops-oncall: insights is a canary rollout with low traffic. If we abort it we can free a slot. Is auth-service critical enough to preempt?

jessica: Yes — 2 customer-facing GDPR endpoints are blocked until this is live. It's urgent.

aakash: If we abort insights canary we lose its validation run. Risk: potential unnoticed regression. But we can rollback auth quickly if needed.

marta: payments must keep its slot. No cancellations there.

devops-oncall: OK — I can authorize a preemptive override for an approved hotfix. @aakash do you approve aborting insights?

aakash: Approve aborting insights canary for this case. We should also pin the auth-service tag to the dedicated hotfix lane in case queue blips.

jessica: How do we pin? quick cmd?

devops-oncall: use the release-fleet override token: `override=preempt;reason=gdpr-hotfix;auth=DEVOPS_AUTH_9`. I'll post approval in the thread now.

deploy-bot: Override request received and validated by oncall. insights v1.9.0 will be aborted and moved back to queue. auth-service v2.14.0 promoted to slot 2 -> new position 1. Starting deploy to prod. Change window: emergency. Release notes: https://intranet.redwood.com/releases/auth-service/2.14.0 

jessica: Thank you — please watch database and sessions.

marta: Noted — payments migration unaffected. watch for connection spikes.

deploy-bot: Starting deployment: auth-service v2.14.0 -> prod. Tag: v2.14.0. Commit: 9f3b2c4. Steps: build -> canary(5%) -> rollout(100%).

aakash: Monitoring setup: dashboards pinned, synthetic checks on, team pager silenced 1m for rollout.

deploy-bot: Canary passed (5% -> healthy). Proceeding to 50% -> 100%.

deploy-bot: Deployment FINISHED — status: SUCCESS. Duration: 1m 23s. Rollout: 100%. Health checks: green. No automatic rollback triggered.

aakash: Confirming metrics look normal for 5m window. No errors spike.

jessica: Will update release notes and notify legal/compliance. Great job everyone :tada:

marta: thanks for the quick coordination.

devops-oncall: Logged override and justification in the release audit: auth-service v2.14.0, reason=gdpr-hotfix, approver=devops-oncall. insights requeued.

deploy-bot: Thread closed. For any fallout open a new incident thread.
